question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option.

The reaction came when he realized the waste and extravagance _______.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"involved"** means to include or be a part of something or someone. (शामिल होना)

 
 
• **Example: **He was deeply **involved** in the community project.
 
 
 
• **involved** refers to being a part of an activity or situation, often in a way that means taking responsibility or being engaged. (शामिल होना)
 
 
• **Example: **The project** involved **many experts from different fields.
 
 
 
• Hence, in the given context, the waste and extravagance were something he realized he was part of or included in.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Hooked **(आसक्त): Captivated or addicted to something.

 
 
• **Example:** She got hooked on the new TV series and watched all the episodes in one day.
 
 
 
• **Participated **(भाग लिया): Took part in an activity or event.
 
 
• **Example: **He participated in the marathon last Sunday.
 
 
 
• **Caught** (पकड़ा): Captured or taken hold of something.
 
 
• **Example:** He caught the ball just before it hit the ground.
